source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence match and curated annotation

entities.name: DHAP reduction to glycerol-3-phosphate
observations: The enzyme catalyzes reversible NAD(P)(H)-dependent interconversion of dihydroxyacetone phosphate and sn-glycerol 3-phosphate.
Oxidative direction: sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + NAD(+) = dihydroxyacetone phosphate + NADH + H(+).
The physiological biosynthetic direction is commonly described as dihydroxyacetone phosphate + NAD(P)H + H(+) = sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + NAD(P)(+).
The reaction is mapped to EC 1.1.1.94 and Rhea RHEA:11092 for NAD+ and RHEA:11096 for NADP+.

entities.name: NAD(P) cofactor usage
observations: Curated annotations support activity with both NAD+ and NADP+; corresponding reductive cofactors are NADH and NADPH.
The protein is annotated with NAD binding (GO:0051287).

entities.name: Glycerophospholipid metabolism
observations: The enzyme supplies sn-glycerol 3-phosphate, a key precursor for phospholipid biosynthesis.
